## Constitution Compliance Verification

**Purpose**: Ensure feature adheres to Identity Project Constitution principles

### Infrastructure-as-Code Compliance (if applicable)

- [ ] CHK-IaC-001: All AWS resources defined in CloudFormation or Terraform
- [ ] CHK-IaC-002: No manual AWS Console changes recorded; drift detection enabled
- [ ] CHK-IaC-003: Infrastructure code reviewed via pull request before deployment
- [ ] CHK-IaC-004: Infrastructure rolled back successfully if deployment failed health checks

### Security by Default Compliance

- [ ] CHK-SEC-001: No credentials, secrets, or API keys committed to repository
- [ ] CHK-SEC-002: Secrets stored in AWS Secrets Manager or environment-based configuration
- [ ] CHK-SEC-003: HTTPS/TLS enabled for all public endpoints (TLS 1.3+ preferred)
- [ ] CHK-SEC-004: IAM policies follow least-privilege principle (no wildcard ARNs except documented)
- [ ] CHK-SEC-005: Admin access requires MFA (if applicable)
- [ ] CHK-SEC-006: S3 buckets private by default; public access only via CloudFront OAI

### Observability and Auditability Compliance

- [ ] CHK-OBS-001: CloudTrail enabled for all infrastructure deployments
- [ ] CHK-OBS-002: CloudWatch logging configured for all applications
- [ ] CHK-OBS-003: Monitoring and alerting rules created for critical metrics
- [ ] CHK-OBS-004: Deployment approved and recorded with timestamp, approver, diff

### Performance and Availability Compliance

- [ ] CHK-PERF-001: Website <2s P95 latency across global regions (if applicable)
- [ ] CHK-PERF-002: CloudFront CDN configured with cache headers and minification
- [ ] CHK-PERF-003: S3 versioning enabled for rollback capability
- [ ] CHK-PERF-004: Blue-green or immutable deployment pattern used (no downtime)
- [ ] CHK-PERF-005: CloudFront cache hit ratio target >90%

### Documentation and Maintainability Compliance

- [ ] CHK-DOC-001: Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) for non-obvious choices documented
- [ ] CHK-DOC-002: CloudFormation/Terraform code includes inline comments
- [ ] CHK-DOC-003: Infrastructure parameters documented in README or deployment guide
- [ ] CHK-DOC-004: Runbooks exist for: deployment, rollback, scaling, failover, updates
- [ ] CHK-DOC-005: New team members can deploy infrastructure without tribal knowledge

### Cost Optimization and Governance Compliance

- [ ] CHK-COST-001: AWS cost estimates reviewed and acceptable
- [ ] CHK-COST-001: CloudWatch spending alerts configured
- [ ] CHK-COST-003: S3 lifecycle policies and Intelligent-Tiering enabled (if applicable)
- [ ] CHK-COST-004: CloudFormation drift detection enabled for production stacks
- [ ] CHK-COST-005: Monthly cost reviews scheduled

## Notes

- Check items off as completed: `[x]`
- Add comments or findings inline

- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
- Constitution compliance is MANDATORY before production deployment
